summary_1line: A massive battle erupts between the monkey army and Ravana’s titans, featuring numerous fierce duels and brutal, chaotic combat.

image_candidates.scene_text: Monkey warriors leap onto fortress walls, dragging demon soldiers down as rocks and trees fly through the air.
Angada smashes Indrajit’s golden chariot, its horses and driver falling amid the clash of armies.
Nila laughs amid a storm of arrows, rips a wheel from a chariot, and beheads the titan Nikumbha on the battlefield.
